revisions.prompt:

Create ONE polished square 1:1 ecommerce gallery image. Input image 1 is the actual product photograph and sole product fact reference. The user wants the clear, premium visual grammar of strong real marketplace listings, adapted to this specific pot.

Use a restrained terracotta-orange accent rule and little accent capsules, not ornamental plants or travertine. Graphite text. Chinese modern sans-serif, bold clear title and deliberately smaller supporting text. Rich light/shadow depth, not flat clipart or an empty white cutout.
Top-left text exactly:
"摩卡壶"
"多面壶身 · 开放式侧柄"
At the bottom in two neat modest informational blocks, exact labels:
"银色壶身"
"黑色侧柄"
No extra copy, badge, invented logo, price or technical numbers. Product still dominates the image; title does not obscure knob or handle.
Preserve the EXACT photographed used object: its faceted upper chamber and lower boiler, cylindrical middle band, black polygonal knob, closed faceted lid, short LEFT pouring spout, RIGHT black angular open-ended handle connected only at the upper hinge and free at bottom. Preserve front/slightly elevated viewpoint and original component proportions. Retain the existing faint middle-band engraving without interpreting/replacing it, retain water spots, fine scratches, dark patches and brown worn bottom edge. Do not polish away product condition, change its metal to a new premium material, recolor silver into gold, create a Bialetti logo, add a valve or show unknown rear/internal structure. This is the same real object with an upgraded gallery layout. Keep entire pot visible.
